{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {qa_orders.shape[0]}")

# Check if any QA orders exist in the data
if qa_orders.shape[0] == 0:
    print("No QA orders found in the dataset.")
else:
    print(f"QA orders found: {qa_orders['order_id'].tolist()}")"}
